entities.name: Ham1-like pyrophosphatase candidate
observations: 216-aa sequence has a Ham1p_like domain (PF01725.22; residues 7–194).
Best reviewed Swiss-Prot match is Q7UGM3, a bacterial dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase: 45.0% identity, 93.5% query coverage, E=1.8e-52.
Homology supports probable hydrolysis of dITP, ITP, and XTP to corresponding monophosphates; Mg2+ dependence is supported by reference annotations, not direct testing of this query.
Estimated molecular mass 23.47 kDa and theoretical pI 10.00.
